formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's USDC allowance for the spender to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it (FiatTokenV2_2 EIP2612._permit → _approve(owner, spender, value)).
The spender can then move up to `value` USDC from the owner with transferFrom until the allowance is used up or changed. The permit has no time limit after it is submitted.
The signature can only be submitted while `deadline` has not passed. A deadline of type(uint256).max means it never expires.
Submitting it uses up the owner's current permit nonce (_permitNonces[owner]++).
formats.shown: The intent "Authorize spending of tokens", with the spender as a raw address, the max amount as a USDC amount ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or above), the deadline as a date, and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the headline does not name the amount or the spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" and no interpolatedIntent. Case 0 shows the amount (2500 USDC) and the spender only in the fields below.
